comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Checked three affected tenants after deploy; balance_due flipped to 0 within one request. Closing.

content.text: Checked three affected tenants after deploy; balance_due flipped to 0 within one request. Closing.

After a customer successfully replaces an expired card in the billing portal, the account summary still shows an unpaid balance equal to the last failed invoice amount. Stripe confirms the new payment method and the retry charge succeeds; only our portal balance widget is wrong.

Expected: balance_due cents drop to 0 and the "Payment past due" alert disappears once invoice status becomes paid. Actual: GET /billing/summary keeps returning the pre-update balance_due for several hours even though invoices list the charge as paid.

Hypothesis: the summary endpoint caches balance_due keyed only by tenant_id with a 6-hour TTL, while the card-update webhook refreshes the invoices collection cache but never busts the summary key. Stale balance wins until the TTL expires or someone hits a forced refresh admin action.
Support is fielding NMS tickets from finance contacts who think the charge failed twice. One account attempted a second card update unnecessarily.
